title: Design System: Stop Biting
scope: Sign surface: src/pages/Landing.tsx and the components it mounts (PricingSection, HeroDemo, ContactForm). Tokens live under .sg-page in src/index.css, not :root. Other surfaces: the editorial .ed-* world (/blog, /pricing chrome, /how-it-works, policy pages) and the signed-in app (Tailwind cream/ink/forest, Inter, light+dark) are separate systems not described here.

components.name: Primary Button (trial)
components.description: Blue enamel plate with an inset white keyline. Reserved for starting the trial; always paired with the offer line.
components.html:
Start free trial

3 days free, no card, then $2.99/month
components.css: .ds-cta { font-family: 'Overpass', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.6rem; min-height: 3.25rem; padding: 0 1.6rem; border-radius: 0.375rem; font-weight: 750; font-size: 1.0625rem; letter-spacing: -0.005em; text-decoration: none; background: oklch(46% 0.13 148); color: #fff; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 3px oklch(46% 0.13 148), inset 0 0 0 5px oklch(100% 0 0 / 0.9); transition: background-color 150ms ease-out, box-shadow 150ms ease-out, transform 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn svg { transition: transform 150ms; } .ds-btn:hover { background: oklch(39% 0.12 148); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 3px oklch(39% 0.12 148), inset 0 0 0 5px #fff; } .ds-btn:hover svg { transform: translateX(2px); } .ds-btn:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid oklch(46% 0.13 148); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-note { margin: 1rem 0 0; font-weight: 650; font-size: 0.9375rem; line-height: 1.45; color: oklch(40% 0.014 255); }

components.name: Ink Button
components.description: White plate with a 2px ink outline; inverts on hover. Every non-trial action.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-ink" type="button"><svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M14.5 4h-5L7 7H4a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v9a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h16a2 2 0 0 0 2-2V9a2 2 0 0 0-2-2h-3l-2.5-3z"/><circle cx="12" cy="13" r="3"/></svg>Try the live demo</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-ink { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.6rem; min-height: 3.25rem; padding: 0 1.6rem; border: 0; border-radius: 0.375rem; font-family: 'Overpass', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-weight: 750; font-size: 1.0625rem; background: #fff; color: oklch(19% 0.014 255); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px oklch(19% 0.014 255); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease-out, color 150ms ease-out, transform 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-ink:hover { background: oklch(19% 0.014 255); color: #fff; } .ds-btn-ink:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-ink:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid oklch(46% 0.13 148); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Light Button on Blue Band
components.description: The closing call to action: a white plate with a reverse blue keyline on the one full blue field.
components.html:
Catch your next bite.

3 days free, no card, then $2.99/month
components.css: .ds-band { background: oklch(46% 0.13 148); color: #fff; padding: 3rem 2rem; font-family: 'Overpass', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-band-h { margin: 0 0 1.5rem; font-weight: 800; font-size: clamp(1.9rem, 1.25rem + 2.2vw, 3.1rem); line-height: 1.04; letter-spacing: -0.025em; } .ds-btn-light { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 3.25rem; padding: 0 1.6rem; border-radius: 0.375rem; font-weight: 750; font-size: 1.0625rem; text-decoration: none; background: #fff; color: oklch(46% 0.13 148); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 3px #fff, inset 0 0 0 5px oklch(46% 0.13 148); transition: background-color 150ms ease-out, box-shadow 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-light:hover { background: oklch(95% 0.03 148); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 3px oklch(95% 0.03 148), inset 0 0 0 5px oklch(46% 0.13 148); } .ds-btn-light:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #fff; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-band-note { margin: 0.75rem 0 0; font-weight: 650; font-size: 0.9375rem; color: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.9); }

components.name: Numbered Step with Mandatory Disc
components.description: A blue mandatory disc with the enamel keyline and a white numeral, beside the step title.
components.html:
1

Sign in with Google

One click, in a new tab. Your 3-day trial starts straight away and asks for no card.
components.css: .ds-step { font-family: 'Overpass', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; max-width: 22rem; } .ds-step-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 1rem; } .ds-disc { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-shrink: 0; width: 3.25rem; height: 3.25rem; border-radius: 999px; background: oklch(46% 0.13 148); color: #fff; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 3px oklch(46% 0.13 148), inset 0 0 0 5px oklch(100% 0 0 / 0.9); font-weight: 850; font-size: 1.375rem; } .ds-step-t { margin: 0; font-weight: 750; font-size: 1.25rem; line-height: 1.25; letter-spacing: -0.01em; color: oklch(19% 0.014 255); } .ds-step-b { margin: 1rem 0 0; font-size: 1.0625rem; line-height: 1.6; color: oklch(40% 0.014 255); }

components.name: Safe-Condition Plate (privacy)
components.description: Green-tint board with a green inset border, headed by a solid green band carrying the square safe sign.
components.html:
Your camera never leaves your device.

Detection runs entirely in your browser: 0 bytes of camera data go to any server.
components.css: .ds-safe { overflow: hidden; border-radius: 0.5rem; background: oklch(96% 0.03 148); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px oklch(46% 0.13 148); font-family: 'Overpass', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-safe-head { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 1.25rem; padding: 2rem; background: oklch(46% 0.13 148); color: #fff; } .ds-safe-sign { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-shrink: 0; width: 3.25rem; height: 3.25rem; border-radius: 0.6rem; background: oklch(46% 0.13 148); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px #fff; } .ds-safe-h { margin: 0; font-weight: 800; font-size: 2rem; line-height: 1.04; letter-spacing: -0.025em; } .ds-safe-body { padding: 2rem; font-size: 1.0625rem; line-height: 1.6; color: oklch(19% 0.014 255); } .ds-safe-body p { margin: 0; } .ds-safe-body strong { font-weight: 800; }

components.name: Pricing Plate (recommended)
components.description: White enamel board, 1.5rem corners; the recommended plan adds a blue inset outline and a pinned plan tag.
components.html:
Best value: save 19%

$29.00/ year

components.css: .ds-plate { position: relative; max-width: 22rem; padding: 2rem; background: #fff; border: 1px solid oklch(89% 0.006 255); border-radius: 1.5rem; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px oklch(46% 0.13 148); font-family: 'Overpass', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; color: oklch(19% 0.014 255); } .ds-tag { position: absolute; top: -0.875rem; left: 1.75rem; margin: 0; padding: 0.25rem 0.625rem; border-radius: 0.25rem; background: oklch(46% 0.13 148); color: #fff; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.8125rem; } .ds-plan { margin: 0; font-weight: 750; font-size: 1.25rem; line-height: 1.25; } .ds-price { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 0.375rem; margin: 1.25rem 0 0; } .ds-fig { font-weight: 850; font-size: clamp(2.5rem, 1.8rem + 2.4vw, 3.75rem); line-height: 1; letter-spacing: -0.03em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-per { margin: 0.5rem 0 0; font-size: 0.9375rem; line-height: 1.5; color: oklch(40% 0.014 255); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: The one place that needs real affordances: white field, visible rule border, blue focus ring.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.625rem; max-width: 24rem; font-family: 'Overpass', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; color: oklch(19% 0.014 255); } .ds-label { font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.9375rem; } .ds-input { width: 100%; padding: 0.75rem 1rem; border: 1px solid oklch(89% 0.006 255); border-radius: 0.75rem; background: #fff; font: inherit; font-size: 1.0625rem; color: oklch(19% 0.014 255); transition: border-color 150ms, box-shadow 150ms; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: oklch(54% 0.012 255); } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: oklch(46% 0.13 148); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px oklch(46% 0.13 148 / 0.3); }

components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1rem; height: 4rem; padding: 0 1.5rem; background: oklch(98.5% 0.004 85 / 0.9); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); border-bottom: 1px solid oklch(89% 0.006 255); font-family: 'Overpass', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-brand { font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.025em; color: oklch(19% 0.014 255); text-decoration: none; } .ds-links { display: flex; gap: 1.75rem; } .ds-links a { font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 600; color: oklch(40% 0.014 255); text-decoration: none; transition: color 150ms; } .ds-links a:hover { color: oklch(19% 0.014 255); } .ds-links a:focus-visible, .ds-nav-btn:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid oklch(46% 0.13 148); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 0.5rem; } .ds-nav-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0 1.1rem; border-radius: 0.375rem; font-weight: 750; font-size: 0.9375rem; text-decoration: none; background: oklch(46% 0.13 148); color: #fff; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 3px oklch(46% 0.13 148), inset 0 0 0 5px oklch(100% 0 0 / 0.9); } .ds-nav-btn:hover { background: oklch(39% 0.12 148); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 3px oklch(39% 0.12 148), inset 0 0 0 5px #fff; }

components.name: Alarm Sign
components.description: Signature: yellow warning triangle, head in profile, dashed threshold ring, rising hand; one 4.2s loop.

components.css: .ds-alarm { width: 100%; max-width: 16rem; } .ds-plate { fill: oklch(86% 0.175 92); stroke: oklch(19% 0.014 255); animation: ds-plate 4.2s linear infinite; } .ds-ink { fill: oklch(19% 0.014 255); } .ds-ring, .ds-hand, .ds-flash { stroke: oklch(19% 0.014 255); } .ds-hand { animation: ds-hand 4.2s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) infinite; } .ds-ring { animation: ds-ring 4.2s linear infinite; } .ds-flash { animation: ds-flash 4.2s linear infinite; } @keyframes ds-hand { 0%, 12% { transform: translate(14px, 20px); } 46%, 70% { transform: translate(0, 0); } 88%, 100% { transform: translate(14px, 20px); } } @keyframes ds-plate { 0%, 44% { fill: oklch(86% 0.175 92); } 48%, 54% { fill: oklch(95% 0.11 95); } 58%, 62% { fill: oklch(86% 0.175 92); } 64%, 68% { fill: oklch(95% 0.11 95); } 72%, 100% { fill: oklch(86% 0.175 92); } } @keyframes ds-ring { 0%, 38% { stroke-dasharray: 5 6; stroke-width: 3; } 46%, 70% { stroke-dasharray: 1 0; stroke-width: 5; } 78%, 100% { stroke-dasharray: 5 6; stroke-width: 3; } } @keyframes ds-flash { 0%, 44% { opacity: 0; } 48%, 54% { opacity: 1; } 58%, 62% { opacity: 0; } 64%, 68% { opacity: 1; } 72%, 100% { opacity: 0; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-plate, .ds-hand, .ds-ring, .ds-flash { animation: none; } .ds-flash { opacity: 1; } .ds-ring { stroke-dasharray: 1 0; stroke-width: 5; } }

notes: 2026-09-25: the animated hand-to-mouth pictogram (AlarmSign) was removed at the owner's request; the hero shows the real Watch screen. Never illustrate the habit itself.
